landing.title: Plan the session. Run the practice. Keep the record.
landing.subtitle: CoachOS is the operating system for coaches and PE teachers — one calm place to plan, deliver and document your training.
landing.statusBody: Accounts, your personal workspace and the basketball drill library — with structured court diagrams — are live. Session planning, lesson plans and teams are being built next; each appears here only when it actually works.

panel.title: Your whole season, on one clipboard.
panel.body: Secure by design: your data stays in your workspace, and only you decide who sees it.

form.title: Title
form.descriptionHint: Shown on cards and in search. {count} of 300 characters.

form.subSkillsHint: Choose up to three areas within the skills above (for example Crossover under Dribbling).
form.subSkillsEmpty: Focus areas appear here once the main or an other skill has some to choose from.
form.tagsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. layups, fast break.
form.organizationHint: How players are grouped and rotate: lines, groups or stations (optional).
form.stepsHint: One step per line, in order.
form.equipmentHint: Tick what the drill needs and say how much.
form.diagramsHint: Draw the drill with players, equipment and movement. Diagrams are structured data: crisp at any size and reusable in sessions and documents.
form.resourcesHint: Up to three: videos (YouTube or Vimeo) or articles. They open in a new tab.
form.visibilityHint: Private drills are visible only to you.
form.privateNote: In your personal workspace, drills are private to you.
